\subsection{Prespecified protein cases}
The principal case 1ULR has 87 mapped residues, held-out PCC 0.570, Spearman correlation 0.624, and normalized RMSE 0.835. The companion 1X3O has 80 mapped residues, PCC 0.492, Spearman correlation 0.530, and normalized RMSE 0.872. Both cases retain their prespecified selection regardless of score. The observed and predicted ribbon colors share the same symmetric scale; signed sheaf contributions use their own stated scale.

The maximum absolute SHAP reconstruction error across the two cases is $4.18\times10^{-8}$ in target z units. The released tables contain all 37 feature attributions per residue, the training-only backgrounds, and model identities. The sheaf-group subtotal shown in Figure~\ref{fig:protein} excludes the graph-feature contribution and the baseline expectation. Consequently its spatial pattern describes this feature group's use by the held-out model, rather than repeating the entire prediction or identifying the influence of neighboring residues.
